title: fix(rest): fold the switched-off action names into the cached object read's ETag
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1Np3hU7RQnA13YZcL

Fixes #28044

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：默认缓存门 `GET /meta/object/:name` 把随对象下发的 `disabledActions`（被启用台账关掉的动作名）折进 ETag；没变化时重新验证答 304，管理员开关动作后答 200 并换新 ETag。spec 里这个键的描述同步改成"折进 ETag"。
- 为什么改：#27964 把 `disabledActions` 放到对象读旁边时，为了正确性让每个带这个键的读都放弃 304；默认部署都挂着台账，所以控制台每次读对象都重新下载整个定义。
- 风险与回滚：只动响应头里的校验值，响应体一个字节不变；没有台账的对象 ETag 和以前逐字节相同。回滚就是 revert 这个 PR，后果只是对象读又不答 304。
- 先看：`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts` 的 `besideJudged`（现在只有 flow 的 `registration` 还让 304 让位）和文件末尾的 `cachedDisabledActionsFingerprint`；然后看 `meta-object-cached-disabled-actions.test.ts`。
- 亲手验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-object-cached-disabled-actions.test.ts`，应看到 8 passed，其中 #28044 的 5 条（304 / 关掉后 200 / 打开后 200 / 缺失与 [] 不同 / 无台账对照 304）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts`, the cached branch of `GET /api/v1/meta/:type/:name`:
  - For an object, the `disabledActions` served beside the item is now a fifth dimension folded into the ETag that this layer already builds and checks for objects (`audienceFolds`). The fingerprint is a hash of the list exactly as served.
  - When the key is absent (no ledger answered), nothing is folded, so the ETag stays byte-identical to the one before this change.
  - `[]` folds a fingerprint of its own, so a ledger being attached or detached also changes the ETag.
  - `besideJudged`, which skips the 304, is now set only by the flow `registration`. That verdict is in no validator, so a flow read that carries it still never gets a 304.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-object-cached-disabled-actions.test.ts`: the old pin "a read that carries the key is never answered 304" is replaced by five #28044 pins:
  - an unchanged object with an unchanged switch set gets 304;
  - switching an action off gets 200 with the new list and a new ETag;
  - switching an action back on gets 200 with `[]` and a new ETag;
  - absent and `[]` give different ETags, in both directions;
  - control: an object with no switched-off actions keeps its 304, and its ETag stays `"etag_task"`.
- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`: only the `GetMetaItemResponseSchema.disabledActions` `.describe()` string. It said the list is "never part of the ETag, so a cached read that carries it is never answered 304"; it now says the list is folded into the ETag, so a cached read revalidates to 304 only while the switched-off set is unchanged. The generated `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` line follows. No shape changes.
- A `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/rest` and `@objectstack/spec`.

The response body is unchanged and no accepted input changes. The list read `GET /meta/object` has no cached or ETag door (`meta-collection-routes.ts` has no ETag handling), so it has nothing to pin.

## Why

#27964 put `disabledActions` beside the object read but kept it out of the validator. To avoid sending a stale list with a 304, it skipped the 304 for every read that carried the key. On a default deployment the ledger is attached, so every cached object read was a full 200. The maintainer approved #27964 as built and asked for the 304s back. Folding the served list into the validator means a 304 is correct again: the ETag now covers what is actually sent.

## Verification

<details><summary>Measured before the fix (tree c1b52de2)</summary>

A cached object read with `disabledActions: ['showcase_mark_done']` was sent back its own ETag as If-None-Match and got 200, not 304 (`AssertionError: expected 200 to be 304`). The ETag was `"etag_task"` whatever the switch set held. The new pins: 5 failed, 3 passed. One part of the control already passed before the fix (no ledger → 304); its `[]` part failed (200).
</details>

<details><summary>After the fix and ablation (commit 8efc06e6)</summary>

- The pins file: 8/8 passed.
- Ablation: `meta-item-read-routes.ts` restored to its c1b52de2 version; the same 5 pins went red, 3 passed. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- <path>`; `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>
